Title: Not Every Strawberry Is Allowed to Be Called "Amaou"

Description:
This Pocky, found at Don Quijote in Osaka, uses Amaou — a Fukuoka strawberry name that only fruit meeting a strict standard is allowed to carry, chosen from 1,913 entries in a 2002 public naming contest. The Pocky itself is noticeably oversized, with reviewers calling it "shockingly huge," and it actually contains 8 percent real Amaou strawberry pulp with a mellow, low-acid strawberry-milk flavor. Sweetness sits at an average 12 to 13 Brix, so if you like more tartness, some fans say they'd still pick the regular strawberry Pocky instead.
